card.architecture: MoE diffusion transformer (high+low noise experts, umT5 encoder) — TEXT-TO-VIDEO
card.summary: Text-to-VIDEO MoE model generating ~5s 720p clips using paired high/low-noise experts. Impractical for single still images.
card.pick_when: User explicitly wants a short VIDEO clip, not a still image.

prompt.guidance: Describe motion, action, camera movement, and scene over time.
prompt.example: Two anthropomorphic cats in boxing gear fight on a spotlighted stage, gloves swinging, crowd lights flickering, dynamic camera slowly pushing in
prompt.overview: Write a fuller natural-language prompt that establishes the subject and scene AND the motion/camera/speed/atmosphere, since the model must invent all visual content from text.
prompt.instructions: Wan 2.2 responds best to detailed, structured natural-language prompts (target ~80-120 words) built in layers: describe the Subject and Scene first, then Motion (what moves and how), then Camera movement (pan, tilt, dolly, orbit, crane, push-in/zoom), then Speed/Intensity (slow, gentle, brisk, slow-motion), then Atmosphere/Aesthetics (lighting, color grade, lens, mood). Put the most important detail early since Wan weights the start of the prompt, and always pair with a negative prompt, which Wan 2.2 enforces more reliably than 2.1.
do: Describe the subject and environment fully before the motion and camera layers
Use concrete motion verbs with explicit speed and direction
Specify a distinct camera move (push-in, dolly out, pan, clockwise orbit, crane, static)
State speed/intensity explicitly (gentle, gradual, rapid, slow-motion)
Add lighting, color grade, lens/shot type, weather, and mood
Put the most important detail early; keep it ~80-120 words
dont: Don't use vague generic action verbs without speed/direction
Don't overload with so many details that key motion gets ignored (avoid >120 words)
Don't omit the subject/scene description (t2v has no source image to define them)
Don't pile on contradictory camera moves or styles in one clip
examples: A lone astronaut in a weathered white spacesuit walks slowly across a red Martian dune at dusk, kicking up fine dust with each step. The camera tracks alongside in a smooth lateral dolly, then arcs into a slow clockwise orbit. Long shadows stretch across the sand, low golden backlight rims the suit, cinematic anamorphic lens with subtle grain, vast and lonely atmosphere, unhurried slow-motion pacing.
prompt.negative_guidance: Wan 2.2 enforces negatives more reliably than 2.1; the canonical default is the Chinese string shipped in the official Wan repo/ComfyUI workflows: 色调艳丽，过曝，静态，细节模糊不清，字幕，风格，作品，画作，画面，静止，整体发灰，最差质量，低质量，JPEG压缩残留，丑陋的，残缺的，多余的手指，画得不好的手部，画得不好的脸部，畸形的，毁容的，形态畸形的肢体，手指融合，静止不动的画面，杂乱的背景，三条腿，背景人很多，倒着走 . For video, add terms like morphing, warping, distortion, flickering, jittering.

speed.measured_note: Not measured — text-to-video model (produces a clip, not a still).

ui_help.note: This makes short videos, not still pictures.
